onboarding_v2_insight_generic: Wherever you are, Aura meets you there. The patterns you shared point to a daily practice that can compound into real shifts within weeks.
onboarding_v2_insight_anxiety_kind: What you're carrying is real. And the kindness you bring to yourself is exactly the foundation we'll build from.
onboarding_v2_insight_anxiety_harsh: What you're carrying is real, and the inner critic only makes it heavier. Aura helps you turn down the volume on that voice so you can find some room to breathe.
onboarding_v2_insight_sleep_kind: When the mind quiets, sleep follows. You already know what you need. We'll help you build the rituals to actually get there.
onboarding_v2_insight_sleep_harsh: Self-criticism keeps the nervous system on low-grade alert, which is why sleep often gets stuck. Aura helps your body learn it's safe to rest again.
onboarding_v2_insight_healing_kind: Healing isn't linear. The gentleness you bring to yourself is exactly what makes the work possible.
onboarding_v2_insight_healing_harsh: Healing happens when the inner voice softens. We'll start by giving you tools to be on your own side, even on the hard days.
onboarding_v2_insight_mood_kind: Mood is a signal, not a verdict. The way you talk to yourself is already on your side, and we'll help that grow.
onboarding_v2_insight_mood_harsh: When the inner voice gets sharp, mood and energy take the hit. Aura helps you catch those moments and meet them with practices that shift things.
onboarding_v2_insight_focus_kind: Focus comes from a quiet mind, and quiet starts with self-compassion. You're closer than you think.
onboarding_v2_insight_focus_harsh: It's hard to focus when the inner voice keeps interrupting. We'll help you build a daily practice that gives the present moment room to breathe.
